status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Lance was a limited participant in Friday's practice due to a groin injury and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.
status.longComment: Lance presumably tweaked his groin during Friday's practice, given that he wasn't listed on the injury report Wednesday or Thursday. DJ Uiagalelei is the Chargers' QB on the practice squad, and he would likely serve as the team's backup to Justin Herbert if Lance is not cleared to play against Buffalo.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Thompson (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
status.longComment: A quadriceps injury prevented Thompson from practicing during Week 3 prep, and the rookie fourth-rounder will look to progress enough in his recovery to return for Week 4 against the Seahawks on Sunday, Oct. 4. Tre' Harris, Derius Davis and Marquez Valdes-Scantling are all in line for a slight bump in offensive reps in Thompson's absence.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Wednesday that Kolar (forearm) won't play Sunday in Buffalo but is expected to avoid placement on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.
status.longComment: After undergoing surgery on his fractured left forearm Monday, Kolar had been expected to head to injured reserve and return after missing the minimum four games. However, Harbaugh noted that Kolar ended up receiving a more favorable prognosis than expected once surgery was completed, and the Chargers are now optimistic that the 27-year-old can return to action prior to their Week 7 bye. Kolar will still need to miss at least one game, and with David Njoku (fibula) still ticketed for IR, Oronde Gadsden appears likely to operate as Los Angeles' clear No. 1 tight end for Week 3.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Chargers placed Njoku (fibula) on injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: Njoku will be sidelined for at least the Chargers' next four games after sustaining a fibula injury in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Raiders. Fellow tight end Charlie Kolar (forearm) was able to avoid placement on IR but has already been ruled out for the Chargers' Week 3 contest in Buffalo, leaving Oronde Gadsden as the top option on the depth chart heading into that game.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Pipkins (knee) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus Buffalo.
status.longComment: Pipkins will miss another game Sunday, meaning his next opportunity to get back on the field will come in Week 4 versus the Seahawks.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Awosika (leg) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
status.longComment: Awosika injured his fibula during the 26-14 loss to the Raiders in Week 2. He's expected to miss time, so Sunday's absence may not be a one-off situation. While Awosika is sidelined, Trevor Penning should take on more work.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Tomlinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
status.longComment: Tomlinson tweaked his hamstring against the Raiders in Week 2, and the injury prevented the veteran defensive lineman from practicing this past week. He'll aim to return for Week 4 against the Seahawks on Sunday, Oct. 4; in the meantime, Justin Eboigbe and Nick Barrett are both in line for an uptick in defensive snaps against Buffalo.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Molden (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
status.longComment: Molden will miss a second consecutive game due to a hamstring injury he sustained in the Chargers' Week 1 loss to the Cardinals. He failed to practice during Week 3 prep, so a return to practice in a limited capacity would put him in the right direction toward playing in Week 4 against the Seahawks on Sunday, Oct. 4. Tony Jefferson should continue to operate in an expanded role in the Chargers' secondary for as long as Molden is sidelined.
